name: Additional Invincibility
body:
Your armor sheds the mightiest blows.

Prerequisite(s): Armored invincibility class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional use of your armored invincibility class feature.

Special: You can select this feat multiple times, each time gaining an additional use of your armored invincibility class feature.
